citations.quote: When hyperpolarized xenon Xe 129 gas is inhaled, a multi-nuclear capable MRI scanner can be used to image the hyperpolarized xenon Xe 129 distribution throughout the ventilated lung. Hyperpolarized xenon Xe 129 nuclei are directly detected by a Xe 129 MRI coil.
